description: This walk takes you from Appledore to Westward Ho along a section of the South West Coast Path. The walk is well sign posted and runs for a distance of just under 5 miles. On the way you will pass Northam Burrows Country Park where you can enjoy grassy coastal plain, salt marsh, sand dunes and grasslands. There are also some excellent coastal views and a fine aspect over the Taw and Torridge River Estuary.
